newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CHICAGO SIGNS AMONTE TO FIVE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CHICAGO SIGNS AMONTE TO FIVE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The Chicago Blackhawks signed restricted free agent right wing Tony Amonte to a five-year contract on Tuesday.

Amonte, who turns 27 on August 2nd, has emerged as one of the top right wings in the NHL. He led the Blackhawks with 41 goals and 77 points, both career-highs, and had an astounding plus-35 rating this past season.
As a Group II free agent, the Blackhawks had the right to match any offer to Amonte and were entitled to compensation if he signed elsewhere.

"I never wanted to leave the Blackhawk organisation or the great city of Chicago," said Amonte at an afternoon news conference at the United Centre. "I have always enjoyed playing in front of Blackhawk fans and I look forward to bringing them to the Stanley Cup, because they certainly deserve it."
Apparently, the New York Rangers, who lost centre Mark Messier to free agency Monday, were interested in reacquiring Amonte.
"The Rangers were definitely always a possibility, especially with the departure of Mark (Messier) right now," said Amonte, who was drafted by the Rangers and played three years in New York.
"But like I said, I'm happy here, and I think the offer I had was very fair. The contract I signed....which they didn't hold a gun to my head to make me sign....is a great contract."

Amonte gave strong indications he was ready to emerge as an NHL All-Star in his performance at the inaugural World Cup of Hockey championship in September. He scored the winning goal in Team USA's triumph over Canada in the decisive game of the World Cup Finals and used it as a springboard for the 1996-97 season.

Amonte scored 35 goals for the Rangers as a rookie. He followed with 33 goals and 76 points in 1992-93, but slipped in his third year with 16 goals in 72 games. He was traded by the Rangers to Chicago in a four-player deal in March, 1994.
After scoring 15 goals in the strike-shortened 1994-95 season, Amonte scored 31 goals in 1995-96 for the Blackhawks.
In his six-year NHL career, Amonte has 172 goals and 190 assists in 451 games. In 50 playoff games, he has 16 goals and 19 assists.
